races.paceDynamic: Red Spells Danger will dictate from the front as the only confirmed leader, but won't face early pressure and can set a sustainable gallop. The real congestion comes behind with Mo Of Cairo, Dandy Breeze, Marcellinus, Gouken, Mighty Magnus, Daizen and Kody B all wanting prominent positions - this creates a wall of horses 2-3 wide turning for home. The hold-up brigade of Cotai Lights, Horace Wallace, Alasrae, Go Vince Go, Proof and Circle Of Trust will need significant gaps to emerge in the final furlong. This pace shape strongly favours the lone leader Red Spells Danger and any prominent runners who can secure clean racing room early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Red Spells Danger gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack gets tangled up
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the chasing pack impedes each other, leaving the hold-up horses with too much to do. Clean sailing throughout gives the pacesetter every chance to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners sort themselves out without major interference behind Red Spells Danger
scenarios.body: The early leaders set honest fractions but the quality horses tracking just behind get clear runs and superior class tells in the final furlong. The pace becomes perfect for horses with tactical speed who avoided the early scramble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or significant gaps appear turning for home
scenarios.body: Either the early pace goes too fast and dies, or the prominent congestion creates openings for the patient hold-up horses to exploit. Superior finishing kicks from Cotai Lights or Go Vince Go prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If Red Spells Danger goes too fast early or the field bunches into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where any horse with room and a turn of foot can win. Experience and jockey skill become crucial in navigating the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early interference as Mo Of Cairo, Dandy Breeze, Marcellinus, Gouken, Mighty Magnus and Daizen all fight for prominent positions behind Red Spells Danger
Monitor Red Spells Danger's early fractions - if he goes too fast trying to build a lead, it opens the door for hold-up horses
Check how quickly the prominent pack sorts itself out in the first two furlongs - clean early positions will determine the winner
Watch for late gaps appearing for Cotai Lights and Go Vince Go if the pace scenario shifts dramatically
Observe Pierre-Louis Jamin's tactics on Marcellinus - his positioning skills could be crucial in this tactical puzzle

races.paceDynamic: Savrola is the only confirmed front-runner and will lead unopposed after his 296-day absence, with Spanish Hustle and Ghaiyya likely to track in second and third positions. The pace will be sustainable rather than demanding, as Savrola won't face pressure from the field of predominantly hold-up horses including Ride The Thunder, Valiancy, Nolton Cross, Mountain Road, and Military Air. With limited early speed beyond the leader, this creates a tactical race where positioning matters more than raw pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks, as the measured gallop will set up a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Savrola sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays honest throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows hold-up horses to get into ideal striking positions turning for home. Late runners with proven finishing kicks can pick off the front-runners in the final two furlongs when the race opens up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Spanish Hustle and Ghaiyya secure perfect tracking positions behind Savrola
scenarios.body: The duo can monitor the pace and strike at the optimal moment when Savrola begins to tire. Their prominent running styles are perfectly suited to this tactical scenario where they avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Savrola returns from his break in peak form and maintains his winning momentum
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead allows him to dictate terms completely, and the field's lack of early pace means nobody can mount a serious challenge. The 1m5f trip suits his stamina-laden profile perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get blocked or forced wide, allowing a horse with a cleaner passage to capitalize. The bunched field turning for home creates chaos that benefits whoever gets the best racing room.

watchPoints.text: Savrola could steal this race if his 296-day absence hasn't dulled his competitive edge and he gets uncontested fractions
Nolton Cross finished last on turf return at Newmarket and his all-weather form may not translate to this surface
Spanish Hustle needs to bounce back quickly from his 211-day break but has proven Hamilton course form
Traffic problems likely in the straight with nine hold-up horses converging from the rear of the field
Trojan Sun carries just 118lbs with Lauren Young's claim and has strong form over this distance on good ground

races.paceDynamic: Station X will lead uncontested in the early stages, setting a sustainable gallop over this minimum trip. Six horses including Jordan Electrics, Master Of My Fate, Vantheman, Manila Scouse, Marty Hopkirk, and Mon Na Slieve all want prominent positions, creating a wall of speed behind the leader that will bunch dangerously 2-3 furlongs out. The congested prominent pack will compromise each other's runs when the pace lifts, while Station X enjoys a clear lead and the hold-up horses find racing room behind the inevitable carnage. This race shape strongly favours either the lone leader or deep closers who can sweep past the faltering prominent brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Station X maintains his uncontested lead without serious pressure until the final furlong
scenarios.body: The wall of prominent runners will engage in their own battle while Station X kicks clear, with any hold-up horses arriving too late over this sharp 5f trip. Station X benefits from tactical isolation while the prominent pack neutralizes itself through over-racing and traffic problems.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the six-horse prominent battle creates unsustainable fractions that crack multiple runners simultaneously
scenarios.body: The early pace will be too strong as prominent runners jostle for position, setting up perfectly for hold-up horses to sweep through tired legs in the final furlong. Reigning Profit and Woohoo can exploit the collapse from their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Special
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes significant interference or blocked runs 2f out
scenarios.body: Multiple prominent runners will find no racing room as the field bunches, creating a lottery where only horses with clear runs can capitalize. Those drawn well or finding gaps will benefit while others are stopped in their tracks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Mon Na Slieve or Master Of My Fate challenges Station X for the early lead
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle will develop between confirmed front-runners, creating a strong gallop that will set up the race perfectly for closers. The early leaders will weaken dramatically in the final 100 yards as hold-up horses time their runs.

watchPoints.text: Station X's ability to maintain uncontested lead - if seriously challenged early, his winning chance diminishes significantly
Traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out as six prominent runners converge - multiple horses will find no racing room
Jordan Electrics getting trapped behind the pace wall despite his superior class and course experience
How quickly the prominent sextet engage - if they go too fast too early, hold-up horses gain major advantage
Little Mi Mi's position tracking the pace - her recent form and low weight make her dangerous if getting clear run

runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a superb 2025 when a six-time winner (including here) but yet to fire this season, beating just one home in a 1m Musselburgh handicap last month; she's 4lb out of the handicap too.

races.paceDynamic: Azahara Palace will take the field along at a sustainable pace from her prominent position, with Dunkeld Dreamer likely to sit just behind in the early stages. The lack of genuine front-runners means Azahara Palace won't face early pressure, allowing her to dictate fractions through the first half-mile. This measured tempo will set up a tactical affair where positioning into the straight becomes crucial, with the pace likely to quicken significantly from the 3f pole. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishes, as they'll benefit from the solid pace and have cover to work with in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest until the 3f pole as expected
scenarios.body: Azahara Palace's measured tempo allows the back-markers to get organized and unleash their finishing kicks. The patient riders can time their challenges perfectly, sweeping past the pace-setters in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Azahara Palace and Dunkeld Dreamer maintain their positions and kick clear early
scenarios.body: The two pace-pressers get first run on the field and establish an unassailable advantage. Their early positioning proves decisive as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling through halfway due to no pace pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 4f pole with all runners bunched together. Superior tactical speed rather than sustained stamina becomes the winning attribute.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Azahara Palace fails to lead or goes too fast early
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with no genuine pace-setter establishing rhythm. This creates a messy, stop-start affair that suits versatile runners who can adapt quickly.

watchPoints.text: Azahara Palace's 220-day absence could see her fade badly if she goes too fast early or lacks race fitness
Seren Star's headgear addition suggests issues, monitor her early settling and Tom Marquand's confidence
Plaid's 3lb weight advantage could prove decisive if the race develops into a sustained staying test

Dunkeld Dreamer's positioning in the first half-mile will indicate whether she leads or sits handy

runners_data.name: Jonny Concrete

races.paceDynamic: Jonny Concrete will set the pace from the front with Mae Amor likely to track him prominently, but with 13 hold-up horses in this field, the early pace will be comfortable and sustainable. The lack of genuine front-runners means Jonny Concrete won't face early pressure, allowing him to dictate fractions. This creates a scenario where the pace will be steady early before quickening in the final 2f as the large pack of hold-up horses fan out seeking room. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently or track the pace, as those coming from the back will struggle to make up ground on what could be a moderate early tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Jonny Concrete gets an easy lead with Mae Amor settling behind him
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady for 4f before the field closes, but the front two will have first run on the field. Prominent racers who can track the pace without being shuffled back will have ideal trips.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Problems
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a wall of hold-up horses with limited room
scenarios.body: The moderate pace will leave too many with chances turning in, causing interference and blocked runs. Those with early tactical speed to avoid trouble will benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Speed
scenarios.trigger: If Mae Amor or Top Juggler go forward to pressure Jonny Concrete early
scenarios.body: A faster early pace will stretch the field and tire the leaders, bringing stamina and finishing kick into play. Late-running handicappers on good marks will benefit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners contest the early pace positioning
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with several groups forming, creating a stop-start tempo. Horses with instant acceleration from any position will thrive.

watchPoints.text: Jonny Concrete must be allowed to stride on early - if Mae Amor or Top Juggler pressure him the pace could collapse
The Good Biscuit and Juan Les Pins need clear runs in the straight as hold-up horses in a big field often get blocked
Top Juggler returning from 195 days off must show early signs of fitness to justify prominent market support
Mae Amor resuming after five months will show in betting moves if connections expect her to reproduce old form
Secret Guest and Stirrup Cup both unlucky last time and need to avoid similar traffic problems in another big field

races.paceDynamic: L'Eagle Aid will likely lead from the start, with Jaminoz potentially joining him in the early positions given their prominent styles. With 10 of 12 runners preferring to hold up, this creates a tactical nightmare where horses will be bunched together seeking racing room in the straight. The sustained pace from L'Eagle Aid won't be pressured early, allowing him to dictate fractions and potentially kick clear when the field comes under pressure. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Dominate Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If L'Eagle Aid and Jaminoz establish clear early positions without pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows them to control fractions and kick clear when the large hold-up contingent gets caught in traffic behind. With 10 horses needing room to manoeuvre late, the early leaders avoid the scramble entirely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear runs and the leaders tire from honest fractions
scenarios.body: Fast Fred and Letsbefrank time their challenges perfectly through gaps, with their proven finishing kicks overcoming the tactical disadvantage. The quality of these late-running handicappers shines through despite the unfavourable race shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If a horse settles in 4th-6th position, avoiding both early pace duties and late traffic
scenarios.body: Polygram or Secret Force benefit from tracking the leaders without being committed early, then having first run on the tiring pace-setters. This tactical position provides the perfect launching pad in a race lacking natural early speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If L'Eagle Aid and Jaminoz go too slow early, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where the best stayers benefit from the crawling pace and explosive finish. Krissy's front-running style could prove effective if she can get past the early leaders when they falter.

watchPoints.text: L'Eagle Aid's jumping and early speed - if he misses the break like last time, the race loses its only reliable pace-setter
Traffic problems at the 2-furlong pole with 10 hold-up horses needing room simultaneously - multiple hard-luck stories inevitable
Jaminoz's positioning in first furlong - needs to be prominent early or gets caught behind the wall of hold-up horses
Sweet Kiss and Secret Force fitness levels after 172 and 237-day breaks respectively - both need to be wound up
Krissy's tactics if the early pace is too slow - she has the pace to take over from crawling leaders
